title: Bangladesh 2024–2026: The Dismantling of a Republic

title: Bangladesh's Oversight Gap: A Preliminary Record
excerpt: Three recurring patterns in Bangladesh's institutional oversight — a shrinking, fragmented civil society, Jamaat-e-Islami's five-decade rehabilitation cycle, and an under-reviewed foreign-infrastructure footprint. A preliminary brief, sourced individually, with open questions stated as plainly as the findings.
author: Futura Genesis Center
